d:
Fall in love all over again with Tujhko Bahon Mein Bhar Liya from the 1994 Bollywood film Jigar, featuring Ajay Devgn and Karisma Kapoor. Sung by the melodious Udit Narayan, this romantic number brings back the nostalgia of 90s Hindi film music.
Tujhko Bahon Mein Bhar Liya | Jigar 1994 | Ajay Devgn, Karisma Kapoor | Udit Narayan, Sadhana Sargam
Song: Tujhko Bahon Mein Bhar Liya
Movie: Jigar (1992)
Star Cast: Ajay Devgn, Karisma Kapoor & Aruna irani
Singers: Udit Narayan, Sadhana Sargam
Music Director: Anand Milind
Lyricist: Sameer
